inventory_status: All selected files inventoried; full C++ declarations/body/relationship extraction is incomplete. File coverage is not correspondence completion.

mapping_rules.source_identity: repository + qualified identifier + kind + full canonical signature; occurrence for duplicate tests; spans are provenance only
mapping_rules.identifiers: Preserve original spelling. Rust keyword: raw identifier where legal; otherwise append __blue. Overload: original name + __sig_ + first 12 hex of SHA256(canonical signature). Constructors: new; destructors: Drop/native field destruction.
mapping_rules.interfaces: Named supertraits, with methods on the actual declaring trait. Concrete bases: composition with explicit delegation.
mapping_rules.canonical_versus_adapters: Canonical Rust types are public source counterparts. PyO3 adapter names and ObjectHandle are auxiliary infrastructure, not extra canonical counterparts.
mapping_rules.replacement_credit: PyO3/native replacement requires concrete facility, version, retained Blue policy, source links and applicable original-test receipts.

platform_obligations.windows: Deferred: inventory all platform branches, file/OS/clipboard/process/network integration and packaging; no acceptance claimed
platform_obligations.macos: Deferred: inventory .mm branches, OS/clipboard/process integrations and packaging; portable behavior remains required on Linux

initial_batch_limitations: Registry implementation is partial; full IBlueClasses trait/method set, IDs, discovery, copying and deferred deletion remain required.

Candidate spans are provenance hints; full declaration/body and macro expansion extraction remains unresolved.
